scene: Candidate Earth gypsy introductory/preparation conversation; runtime source confirmation pending

entries.target: 歡迎，旅人。請坐。
entries.speaker: Gypsy
entries.context: Earth gypsy: greeting / journey / preparation / not-ready return branch

entries.target: 你好，Avatar；Britannia 正等著你。
entries.speaker: Gypsy
entries.context: Earth gypsy: greeting / journey / preparation / not-ready return branch

entries.target: 這將是你最艱鉅的挑戰：
entries.speaker: Gypsy
entries.context: Earth gypsy: greeting / journey / preparation / not-ready return branch

entries.target: 為 Britannia 的命運而戰的最後一役。
entries.speaker: Gypsy
entries.context: Earth gypsy: greeting / journey / preparation / not-ready return branch

entries.target: 若你踏上這趟旅程，
entries.speaker: Gypsy
entries.context: Earth gypsy: greeting / journey / preparation / not-ready return branch

entries.target: 便再也回不了地球，也不會再回到 Britannia。
entries.speaker: Gypsy
entries.context: Earth gypsy: greeting / journey / preparation / not-ready return branch

entries.target: 你準備好迎接這項至關重要的使命了嗎？
entries.speaker: Gypsy
entries.context: Earth gypsy: greeting / journey / preparation / not-ready return branch

entries.target: 什麼旅程？
entries.speaker: Avatar
entries.context: Earth gypsy: greeting / journey / preparation / not-ready return branch

entries.target: 我該做些什麼準備？
entries.speaker: Avatar
entries.context: Earth gypsy: greeting / journey / preparation / not-ready return branch

entries.target: 我準備好了！
entries.speaker: Avatar
entries.context: Earth gypsy: greeting / journey / preparation / not-ready return branch

entries.target: 長久以來，你一直是 Britannia 的救星。
entries.speaker: Gypsy
entries.context: Earth gypsy: greeting / journey / preparation / not-ready return branch

entries.target: 過去你曾八度踏上這趟旅程，讓 Britannia 免於毀滅。
entries.speaker: Gypsy
entries.context: Earth gypsy: greeting / journey / preparation / not-ready return branch

entries.target: 這一次，你必須徹底完成使命。
entries.speaker: Gypsy
entries.context: Earth gypsy: greeting / journey / preparation / not-ready return branch

entries.target: 因為這趟旅程結束後，你將走向不同的未來。
entries.speaker: Gypsy
entries.context: Earth gypsy: greeting / journey / preparation / not-ready return branch

entries.target: 你已熟練戰鬥、游泳，以及裝備的使用方法了嗎？
entries.speaker: Gypsy
entries.context: Earth gypsy: greeting / journey / preparation / not-ready return branch

entries.target: 我還沒準備好。
entries.speaker: Avatar
entries.context: Earth gypsy: greeting / journey / preparation / not-ready return branch

entries.target: 我已經準備好了！
entries.speaker: Avatar
entries.context: Earth gypsy: greeting / journey / preparation / not-ready return branch

entries.target: 準備好之後，再回來找我吧。
entries.speaker: Gypsy
entries.context: Earth gypsy: greeting / journey / preparation / not-ready return branch

entries.target: 你得先探索這座森林。
entries.speaker: Gypsy
entries.context: Earth gypsy: greeting / journey / preparation / not-ready return branch

entries.target:
這裡有許多知識能在旅途中幫助你。前往 Britannia 之前，先
學會游泳與戰鬥吧！
entries.speaker: Gypsy
entries.context: Earth gypsy: greeting / journey / preparation / not-ready return branch
